Brendan Rodgers will therefore want his side to bring the confidence of their recent attacking performances into this fixture while avoiding any [...] Their latest listed result was a 4–1 home win over Al Faisaly, which should provide a boost to the squad’s confidence. However, the away numbers remain a concern for coach Fábio Carille. Al Fayha have not won any of their six league matches on the road, drawing three and losing three. Finding a way to threaten consistently away from home will be important if they are to challenge the hosts. Their overall goal tally shows they can score, but the defensive record and lack of away victories make [...] Al Qadsiah are the clear favourites on the information available. Al Fayha, by contrast, have yet to win on the road this season, drawing three and losing three of their six away games.
